unit.title: Is that really what happened?

grammar.pattern: 白 / 并 / 当然 / 到底 / 反正 / 根本 / 果然 / 简直 / 绝对 / 难道 / 其实 / 千万 / 确实 / 只好 / 终于
grammar.explanation: 白跑 means a trip in vain. 并没有 challenges an assumed cancellation; it is not English however by itself. 根本不是 strengthens negation. 果然 says a finding matches an expectation, not that expectation alone proves it. 其实 and 事实上 introduce a correction. 绝对 is a strong commitment; avoid it for a guess. 千万别 is emphatic caution, 只好 constrained choice, 终于 an eventual result. Attitude adverbs do not supply evidence.

examples.zh: 活动并没有取消，只是换了房间。
examples.py: huó dòng bìng méi yǒu qǔ xiāo , zhǐ shì huàn le fáng jiān .
examples.en: The event is not cancelled; only the room changed.

examples.zh: 果然是旧日期，今天的时间没变。
examples.py: guǒ rán shì jiù rì qī , jīn tiān de shí jiān méi biàn .
examples.en: It is an old date as expected; today’s time is unchanged.

examples.py: qiān wàn bié bǎ cāi cè dāng shì shí .
examples.en: Be sure not to treat a guess as fact.

commonMistakes.wrong: 果然，我猜了，所以是真的。
commonMistakes.right: 核对后，果然和我猜的一样。
commonMistakes.why: 果然 comments on a verified outcome matching an expectation.

grammar.explanation: 不是写着换房间吗？ points to information the speaker expects the listener to acknowledge. 难道旧图片就能证明今天取消了吗？ challenges that inference and expects no; it is not neutral uncertainty about any cancellation. Tone and context matter. For a genuinely open question use 活动取消了吗？ without forcing agreement.

examples.py: bù shì xiě zhe huàn fáng jiān ma ?
examples.en: Does it not say the room changed?

examples.zh: 难道旧图片就能证明今天取消了吗？
examples.py: nán dào jiù tú piàn jiù néng zhèng míng jīn tiān qǔ xiāo le ma ?
examples.en: Can an old picture really prove today’s cancellation?

examples.py: huó dòng qǔ xiāo le ma ?

commonMistakes.wrong: 难道旧图能证明吗？一定是在认真问图片大小。
commonMistakes.right: 难道旧图能证明吗？是在质疑这个判断。
commonMistakes.why: The rhetorical question challenges an inference, not image dimensions.

lines.zh: 你怎么站在门外？活动还没开始吧？
lines.py: nǐ zěn me zhàn zài mén wài ? huó dòng hái méi kāi shǐ ba ?
lines.en: Why are you outside? The event hasn't started yet, has it?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我收到一张图，说今天取消了。
lines.py: wǒ shōu dào yī zhāng tú , shuō jīn tiān qǔ xiāo le .
lines.en: Someone sent me an image saying it was cancelled today.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 让我看看。这上面是上个月的日期。
lines.py: ràng wǒ kàn kàn . zhè shàng miàn shì shàng gè yuè de rì qī .
lines.en: Let me see. That's last month's date.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 啊，我白跑一趟了？
lines.py: a , wǒ bái pǎo yī tàng le ?
lines.en: Oh, have I come all this way for nothing?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不是，今天并没有取消，只是换到二楼。
lines.py: bù shì , jīn tiān bìng méi yǒu qǔ xiāo , zhǐ shì huàn dào èr lóu .
lines.en: No. It hasn't been cancelled today; it's moved upstairs.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你怎么知道？
lines.py: nǐ zěn me zhī dào ?
lines.en: How do you know?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我刚问了门口的工作人员，新通知也贴在这儿。
lines.py: wǒ gāng wèn le mén kǒu de gōng zuò rén yuán , xīn tōng zhī yě tiē zài zhèr .
lines.en: I just asked the staff member by the door. The new notice is here too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 果然，写着二楼。那赶紧上去吧。
lines.py: guǒ rán , xiě zhe èr lóu . nà gǎn jǐn shàng qù ba .
lines.en: You're right: it says the second floor. Let's go up quickly.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 时间没变，七点开始，还早。
lines.py: shí jiān méi biàn , qī diǎn kāi shǐ , hái zǎo .
lines.en: The time hasn't changed. It starts at seven. We've time.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 千万别告诉大家我看错日期。
lines.py: qiān wàn bié gào sù dà jiā wǒ kàn cuò rì qī .
lines.en: Please don't tell everyone I got the date wrong.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我不说，你下次先把图放大。
lines.py: wǒ bù shuō , nǐ xià cì xiān bǎ tú fàng dà .
lines.en: I won't. Zoom in on the image first next time.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。我刚才根本没看下面那一行。
lines.py: hǎo . wǒ gāng cái gēn běn méi kàn xià miàn nà yī xíng .
lines.en: Okay. I didn't look at the bottom line at all.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: A true image can be out of date
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.

lines.zh: 我六点半到活动室门口，看见陈宇站在外面。他拿着手机，说今天的活动取消了，我差点也跟着往回走。
lines.py: wǒ liù diǎn bàn dào huó dòng shì mén kǒu , kàn jiàn chén yǔ zhàn zài wài miàn . tā ná zhuó shǒu jī , shuō jīn tiān de huó dòng qǔ xiāo le , wǒ chà diǎn yě gēn zhe wǎng huí zǒu .
lines.en: I arrived at the activity room at six thirty and found Chen Yu outside with his phone. He said the event was cancelled. I almost headed home with him.

lines.zh: 他把图片给我看，我注意到下面有日期，是上个月的。我把图放大，他终于看清楚，问今天是不是仍然在这里。
lines.py: tā bǎ tú piàn gěi wǒ kàn , wǒ zhù yì dào xià miàn yǒu rì qī , shì shàng gè yuè de . wǒ bǎ tú fàng dà , tā zhōng yú kàn qīng chǔ , wèn jīn tiān shì bú shì réng rán zài zhè lǐ .
lines.en: He showed me the image. The date at the bottom was from last month. I zoomed in, and he finally saw it and asked whether today's event was still here.

lines.zh: 门口的工作人员告诉我们，今天换到二楼，时间没变，仍是七点开始。旁边贴着一张新通知，上面也写得清楚。
lines.py: mén kǒu de gōng zuò rén yuán gào sù wǒ men , jīn tiān huàn dào èr lóu , shí jiān méi biàn , réng shì qī diǎn kāi shǐ . páng biān tiē zhe yī zhāng xīn tōng zhī , shàng miàn yě xiě de qīng chǔ .
lines.en: The staff member said today's event had moved to the second floor, still starting at seven. The new notice beside the door said the same.

lines.zh: 陈宇把新通知拍下来，发给同来的两个朋友。一个朋友已经快到了，说幸好看到消息，刚才也准备回家。
lines.py: chén yǔ bǎ xīn tōng zhī pāi xià lái , fā gěi tóng lái de liǎng gè péng you . yī gè péng you yǐ jīng kuài dào le , shuō xìng hǎo kàn dào xiāo xī , gāng cái yě zhǔn bèi huí jiā .
lines.en: Chen Yu photographed the new notice and sent it to two friends coming along. One was nearly there and was glad of the message: they'd been about to go home too.

lines.zh: 我们先上楼，找了四个连在一起的位子。两位朋友过来坐下，一个笑着问陈宇，是不是上个月就来过。
lines.py: wǒ men xiān shàng lóu , zhǎo le sì gè lián zài yì qǐ de wèi zi . liǎng wèi péng you guò lái zuò xià , yī gè xiào zhe wèn chén yǔ , shì bú shì shàng gè yuè jiù lái guò .
lines.en: We went upstairs and found four seats together. When the friends sat down, one jokingly asked Chen Yu whether he'd come last month already.

lines.zh: 陈宇说没有，不过上个月的日期倒是认识了。我把手机收好，演出正好开始，这一趟总算没白来。
lines.py: chén yǔ shuō méi yǒu , bù guò shàng gè yuè de rì qī dǎo shì rèn shi le . wǒ bǎ shǒu jī shōu hǎo , yǎn chū zhèng hǎo kāi shǐ , zhè yī tàng zǒng suàn méi bái lái .
lines.en: No, said Chen Yu, but he now knew last month's date well. I put away my phone as the show began. The trip hadn't been for nothing after all.

choices: They send the correct notice and attend the show

questions.q: How many seats do they find together?
Why is one friend glad of the message?
choices: They had been about to head home too
They wanted to buy a coat

lines.en: Of course you can come if you'd like to.

lines.zh: 当然，我也记得那一天。
lines.py: dāng rán , wǒ yě jì de nà yī tiān .
lines.en: Of course I remember that day too.

lines.zh: 你到底想吃什么？
lines.py: nǐ dào dǐ xiǎng chī shén me ?
lines.en: What exactly do you want to eat?

lines.zh: 钥匙到底放哪儿了？
lines.py: yào shi dào dǐ fàng nǎr le ?
lines.en: Where on earth did I put the keys?

lines.zh: 反正还早，再坐一会儿吧。
lines.py: fǎn zhèng hái zǎo , zài zuò yī huì er ba .
lines.en: It's still early anyway. Stay a little longer.

lines.zh: 反正我也要出门，一起走吧。
lines.py: fǎn zhèng wǒ yě yào chū mén , yì qǐ zǒu ba .
lines.en: I'm going out anyway. Let's go together.

lines.zh: 我根本没听见你叫我。
lines.py: wǒ gēn běn méi tīng jiàn nǐ jiào wǒ .
lines.en: I didn't hear you calling me at all.

lines.zh: 那家店根本不在这条街上。
lines.py: nà jiā diàn gēn běn bù zài zhè tiáo jiē shàng .
lines.en: That shop isn't on this street at all.

lines.zh: 你说这里有猫，果然有。
lines.py: nǐ shuō zhè lǐ yǒu māo , guǒ rán yǒu .
lines.en: You said there were cats here, and sure enough there are.

lines.zh: 天气预报说会下雨，果然下了。
lines.py: tiān qì yù bào shuō huì xià yǔ , guǒ rán xià le .
lines.en: The forecast said rain, and it did rain.

lines.zh: 这件外套简直太大了。
lines.py: zhè jiàn wài tào jiǎn zhí tài dà le .
lines.en: This coat is simply enormous.

lines.zh: 等了一个小时，我简直想回家了。
lines.py: děng le yī gè xiǎo shí , wǒ jiǎn zhí xiǎng huí jiā le .
lines.en: After an hour's wait, I practically wanted to go home.

lines.zh: 这次我绝对不迟到。
lines.py: zhè cì wǒ jué duì bù chí dào .
lines.en: I absolutely won't be late this time.

lines.zh: 这张照片绝对不是我拍的。
lines.py: zhè zhāng zhào piān jué duì bù shì wǒ pāi de .
lines.en: I definitely didn't take this photo.

lines.zh: 难道你又忘了带钥匙？
lines.py: nán dào nǐ yòu wàng le dài yào shi ?
lines.en: Don't tell me you forgot your keys again?

lines.zh: 难道我们要一直站在雨里？
lines.py: nán dào wǒ men yào yì zhí zhàn zài yǔ lǐ ?
lines.en: Are we supposed to stand in the rain forever?

lines.zh: 其实我已经吃过饭了。
lines.py: qí shí wǒ yǐ jīng chī guò fàn le .
lines.en: Actually, I've already eaten.

lines.zh: 他看起来生气，其实只是困了。
lines.py: tā kàn qǐ lái shēng qì , qí shí zhǐ shì kùn le .
lines.en: He looks angry, but he's just sleepy.

lines.zh: 千万别忘了带票。
lines.py: qiān wàn bié wàng le dài piào .
lines.en: Make sure you don't forget your ticket.

lines.zh: 千万别把这个杯子丢了。
lines.py: qiān wàn bié bǎ zhè gè bēi zi diū le .
lines.en: Please don't lose this cup.

lines.zh: 这家店的菜确实很好吃。
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn de cài què shí hěn hǎo chī .
lines.en: The food at this shop really is good.

lines.zh: 今天确实比昨天暖和。
lines.py: jīn tiān què shí bǐ zuó tiān nuǎn huo .
lines.en: It really is warmer today than yesterday.

lines.zh: 没带伞，我只好等雨停。
lines.py: méi dài sǎn , wǒ zhǐ hǎo děng yǔ tíng .
lines.en: I didn't bring an umbrella, so I had to wait for the rain to stop.

lines.zh: 店关门了，我们只好换一家。
lines.py: diàn guān mén le , wǒ men zhǐ hǎo huàn yī jiā .
lines.en: The shop was closed, so we had to choose another.

lines.zh: 车终于来了。
lines.py: chē zhōng yú lái le .
lines.en: The bus is finally here.

lines.zh: 我终于找到了那本书。
lines.py: wǒ zhōng yú zhǎo dào le nà běn shū .
lines.en: I finally found that book.

lines.zh: 他迟到了，这是事实。
lines.py: tā chí dào le , zhè shì shì shí .
lines.en: He was late. That's a fact.

lines.zh: 我想先把事实弄清楚。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng xiān bǎ shì shí nòng qīng chǔ .
lines.en: I'd like to establish the facts first.

lines.zh: 事实上，他比我早到。
lines.py: shì shí shàng , tā bǐ wǒ zǎo dào .
lines.en: In fact, he arrived before me.

lines.zh: 事实上，这两张照片是同一天拍的。
lines.py: shì shí shàng , zhè liǎng zhāng zhào piān shì tóng yī tiān pāi de .
lines.en: In fact, these two photos were taken on the same day.

lines.zh: 只看照片，很难判断大小。
lines.py: zhǐ kàn zhào piān , hěn nán pàn duàn dà xiǎo .
lines.en: It's hard to judge the size from a photo alone.

lines.zh: 你怎么判断他已经走了？
lines.py: nǐ zěn me pàn duàn tā yǐ jīng zǒu le ?
lines.en: How did you conclude that he'd left?

lines.zh: 收到你的消息，我很高兴。
lines.py: shōu dào nǐ de xiāo xī , wǒ hěn gāo xìng .
lines.en: I'm happy to have heard from you.

lines.zh: 我给家里发了一条消息。
lines.py: wǒ gěi jiā lǐ fā le yī tiáo xiāo xī .
lines.en: I sent a message home.

lines.zh: 请把这张纸传给后面的人。
lines.py: qǐng bǎ zhè zhāng zhǐ chuán gěi hòu miàn de rén .
lines.en: Please pass this paper to the people behind you.

lines.zh: 这个消息是小周传给我的。
lines.py: zhè gè xiāo xī shì xiǎo zhōu chuán gěi wǒ de .
lines.en: Xiao Zhou passed this news to me.

lines.zh: 这首歌很快就在网上传播开了。
lines.py: zhè shǒu gē hěn kuài jiù zài wǎng shàng chuán bō kāi le .
lines.en: This song spread quickly online.

lines.zh: 他们用短视频传播家乡的故事。
lines.py: tā men yòng duǎn shì pín chuán bō jiā xiāng de gù shì .
lines.en: They share stories of their hometown through short videos.

lines.zh: 这个故事有真实的背景。
lines.py: zhè gè gù shì yǒu zhēn shí de bèi jǐng .
lines.en: This story has a real-life background.

lines.zh: 她把真实的想法告诉了我。
lines.py: tā bǎ zhēn shí de xiǎng fǎ gào sù le wǒ .
lines.en: She told me what she really thought.

audio.zh: 不是，今天并没有取消，只是换到二楼。
audio.py: bù shì , jīn tiān bìng méi yǒu qǔ xiāo , zhǐ shì huàn dào èr lóu .
audio.en: No. It hasn't been cancelled today; it's moved upstairs.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三19, 三76. Native check: 白跑, 并 with negation, 反正 versus indifference, 果然 expectation and evidence, strong 绝对, rhetorical question polarity and polite alternatives. Distinguish 纪录 as record from 记录 as recording. No unverified claims marked facts. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三13 / 三37 / 三16 / 三17: 至少提前一天，提前两天也可以。, 材料有的是，名额还要确认。, 等听清楚了再加快。, 我亲自读，你帮我听。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Replaced policy-like lines with rainy-day lunch and muddy-shoe teasing, a wrong-date mix-up, student-union registration and travel photos, and a move with tools, a desk and books. All 88 existing vocabulary IDs get two independent contexts; tasks and grammar ownership preserved. Self-review: class rules out morning, lunch around two, walk after three; old cancellation image and current second-floor seven-o’clock show; four classmates, one representative, two-minute talk, host Xiao Zhou; small box tools, large box books, desk assembled below then carried up, narrator goes down and comes back up. False listening statements contradict their own clip. Native flags: 保险 safer versus insurance, written 仍, empathetic 恐怕, rhetorical 难道, student-union 部长/主任 titles, 代表 token sense, 朝 cháo and 背 bēi, directional 上来/上去/下来/下去 tied to speaker position, and teasing personification of dates/books.
